observations.content: 2024-03 rename of org_id to workspace_id broke partner integrations for 2 weeks. Root cause: API responses changed field names without deprecation, and 3 partner systems were parsing the JSON by field name.
Post-mortem finding: the rename was treated as a simple find-and-replace, but serialized data in Redis cache and partner webhook payloads still contained the old field name for days after deployment.
API field renames require minimum 6-month deprecation window per API versioning policy. Both old and new field names must be returned simultaneously during the deprecation period.
Breaking changes to external-facing API responses must be communicated to partners at least 90 days in advance with migration documentation.
